compares_to.attriguard_l2: Table 4 'AttriGuard (default, lambda=2)', p.13, GPT-4.1-mini backbone+aux: BU 70.59% (24/34), UA 66.96% (154/230), ASR 0.00% (0/230)

compares_to.fidelity_kind: backbone-substituted (DeepSeek deepseek-flash replaces GPT-4.1-mini as target and aux); not an exact reproduction

deviations: D1 backbone substitution: deepseek-flash for target, shadow, attenuation and judge (paper Table 4: GPT-4.1-mini for both).

D2 model routing: the artifact's own OpenAILLM on a routed client instead of provider 'openai'/'local'; the local backend hard-codes ids and ports (my_agent_pipeline.py:117-135). Aux LLMs keep the released openai-backend settings (temperature 0.2, top_p 0.9).

D3 wire normalisation (same as the lab's deepseek_adapter): list content joined to a string, tool-message 'name' dropped, developer->system, thinking disabled, max_tokens=2048 added (the artifact sets no output cap), SDK max_retries=0 (the artifact's own tenacity retry, 3 attempts, is kept).

D4 judge logprobs: forwarded as released (logprobs=True, top_logprobs=5). If DeepSeek rejects them with HTTP 400/422, the adapter raises the exact wording the released fallback handles ('logprobs ... unsupported') and stops sending logprobs for the rest of the run. Whether deepseek-flash returns logprobs is UNVERIFIED; S1 records it.

D5 attack text: agentdojo 0.1.35 has no DeepSeek MODEL_NAMES entry; the adapter registers 'deepseek-flash' -> 'AI assistant' (the paper's model-name text for GPT-4.1-mini is UNVERIFIED, NOTES.md row 12).

D6 suite: v1.2.2 with explicit exclusions (banking minus user_task_12; slack minus user_task_18/19) so slack injection_task_5 stays in: 230 attacked instances, matching the Table 4 arithmetic rather than the release's v1.2.3 (211).

D7 episode driver: AgentDojo run_task_with/without_injection_tasks per episode instead of my_benchmark.benchmark_suite, so the injection-task-as-user-task pre-run (not used by BU/UA/ASR) is skipped, load_dotenv is never called, and rows are interleaved per pair.
D8 instrumentation: a subclass of AttriGuardExecutionLoop records the decision route of each _fuzzy_survive call; it calls the released method unchanged.
D9 run count: one run per row (the paper reports 3-5 runs; NOTES.md section 7 blocker 6).
